answer: Thermal-radiance PUF attestation curbs Sybil attacks in an agent economy by binding each node to a ceramic cell the size of a walnut housing a MEMS filament. An auditor drives a nonce-keyed pulse train that heats the filament to an ember glow and checks the photodiode cooling curve against its enrolled profile. Remote hosts cannot harbor virtual clones since each identity requires fabricating and powering separate hardware. Yet filament wear or window dust shifts emission and can block honest nodes.
